capabilities: Edit link display text and target in a popover
Copy links in a preferred format
Autocomplete internal file and heading link targets
extras: Developed with AI assistance and actively used by the author in their own vault; documents an iOS limitation where scrolling cannot start from a link area in Click trigger mode; accepts donations via Ko-fi.
problem: Editing a link in Obsidian means manually modifying its Markdown or WikiLink syntax in the text, which is slow and error-prone.

relations.evidence: This idea and solution are inspired by Octarine.
This project is based on David V. Kimbal's obsidian-sample-plugin-plus

summary: Click-to-edit popover for links in the Markdown editor, letting you change display text and target and run quick actions like open, copy, or delete.
